# FIC Technologies

> FIC Technologies builds continuous risk governance and capital protection infrastructure for modern financial markets.

Canonical website: https://fictechs.com/
Location: 9 Adamu Ciroma Crescent, Jabi, Abuja, Nigeria
Email: info@fictechs.com
Telephone: +234 707 070 4095

## Organisation

FIC means Financial Infrastructure & Compliance. FIC provides a governance layer connecting verified identity, behavioural competence, risk boundaries, mandate controls and auditable evidence for participation in financial markets.

FIC does not execute trades, hold client funds, act as a broker, replace regulatory authority or guarantee investment returns. Capital remains within licensed or custodial institutions.

## Infrastructure

### FIC Core

FIC Core governs participation in traded markets. It supports trader identity and TLN credentialing, governance plans, risk boundaries, continuous behaviour and exposure monitoring, and permissioned performance evidence.

### Capital Hub

Capital Hub extends FIC's governance model into investment and capital allocation. It supports governed opportunities, investor mandates, permissioned due diligence, licensed institution coordination and ongoing reporting and exit controls.

## Stakeholders

- Traders: professional identity, behavioural evidence and visible risk boundaries.
- Individual and institutional investors: mandate definition, governed participation and ongoing oversight.
- Licensed institutions: clearer participation controls and auditable governance evidence.
- Regulators: structured identity, conduct and risk evidence that can support supervision and policy enforcement.

## Core concepts

- Continuous risk governance
- Capital protection
- Financial market participation governance
- Trader License Number and TLN credentialing
- Investor mandate governance
- Structured regulatory evidence
